title: [Bug] ZCode 接入 magpie 后用一段时间会自动退出接入状态，需要手动重新接入
head: c4495b30c80801ca794bc9abcffe456d75339661
unverifiedBoundaries: ZCode 3.16.2 itself was not installed or run; the file rewrite that triggers the loss is simulated from the reporter's evidence (both files losing magpie's provider while the gateway stayed up).
The restore happens on the syncs magpie already runs (start-up, catalog changes), so a rewrite while magpie runs is repaired at the next such sync, not instantly.
Disconnect through magpie and a provider removed in ZCode's own settings page keep their existing behavior; a removal from an old ZCode that keeps providers in config.json alone is still respected.
